items.item_text: Athletic Equipment Managers Association (AEMA) certified or cert
Bachelor's Degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Equipment operations experience working in Division I Athletics and/or professional sports.
Prior experience in ordering through an all-school apparel agreement.
Experience performing general repairs and maintenance on a wide variety of athletic apparel and equipment.
Knowledge (or experience) and skills to properly fit with measuring techniques student-athletes for protective equipment.

Under guidance of the Assistant Athletics Director-Equipment Room Operations, provide support services in the day-to-day activities of a 25- sport operation out of Hickey Gym and the Pavilion Arena. Serve the student-athletes, head and assistant coaches, and staff of assigned sports.Perform equipment, apparel, laundry, and locker room operations for the equipment rooms. Provide proper care, maintenance and laundry service for assigned Intercollegiate Athletic teams.
Computer skills to utilize various programs and software for word processing, spreadsheets, and equipment inventory on a Macintosh and/or a PC.
Knowledge of Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) standards. Knowledge of how to operate industrial laundry equipment.

Organizational and time management skills; attention to detail.Interpersonal customer service, oral and written communication skills to work effectively and establish cooperative working relationships with persons from diverse backgrounds and at various organizational levels within and outside the University.
Ability to maintain composure a high-energy environment; problem solving skills; effective listener.
